Screenshots album organization vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos screen-capture capability on device covers storefront language. Capture hardware shortcuts, AssistiveTouch, and Connect actually separate in-app screenshot behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Screenshots — the system album where iOS screen captures land on the buyer's device. Controls on-device organization — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Volume-up+side-button capture — the primary hardware shortcut buyers use to save a screen capture. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building capture UI is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • AssistiveTouch screenshot — accessibility-driven capture when buyers use AssistiveTouch instead of hardware buttons. Listing copy may mention AssistiveTouch paths; implementing capture accessibility is in-app engineering.
  • Screenshot markup — post-capture annotation, crop, and markup editing before or after save. Listing copy names markup value; building markup editors is engineering.
  • Full-page Safari screenshots — long web-page captures that also appear under Screenshots when saved from Safari. Listing copy should explain that relationship when your English gallery shows it — without making Safari the primary hero unless your frames show it.
  • Find screenshots & distinguish from Recents — buyers open the Screenshots album to locate screen captures instead of scrolling Camera Roll or Recents. Listing copy names that path; building album-grid UI is engineering.
  • Recover a capture after markup — product-page copy may describe reverting markup or finding the original capture when your English listing claims that workflow.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Screenshots support in the binary.

Working Screenshots album organization and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Screenshots, 截屏相簿, and 屏幕截图 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire screen capture in code.

Screenshots-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Screenshots listings use vocabulary general photo-library guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe screen captures — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Screenshots & 截屏相簿

US pages use "Screenshots" on the album grid under Photos → Albums. China storefront copy often uses 截屏相簿 alongside the product name Screenshots where appropriate on screenshot overlays — especially on album-header and screen-capture grid frames.

Screen capture & 屏幕截图 / 截图

Screen-capture value props — shots saved with volume-up+side-button or AssistiveTouch — appear frequently on Screenshots marketing frames. zh-Hans copy should describe that path with 屏幕截图 or 截图 when that matches your English source — without inventing capture claims your listing does not support.

屏幕快照

Some English listings use "screen snapshot" phrasing on capture frames. Chinese buyers may search 屏幕快照 for snapshot-style screen-capture marketing — related to 屏幕截图 but useful as keyword overlap when your English gallery uses snapshot wording.

Screenshot markup & 截屏标记

Post-capture annotation, crop, and markup editing flows need verb phrases Chinese readers recognize. Frames should pair 截屏标记 with the UI your gallery actually shows — markup toolbar, crop handles, or annotation pens after capture.

Full-page Safari screenshots & AssistiveTouch captures

Long web-page captures and AssistiveTouch-driven saves also land in Screenshots. Listing copy should explain why those captures appear here when your English gallery shows Safari full-page or AssistiveTouch paths — without conflating Screenshots with Safari or AssistiveTouch marketing alone.

Find screenshots & distinguish from Recents

Action-oriented screenshots — open Screenshots to find screen captures, compare Screenshots vs Camera Roll or Recents — need clear zh-Hans phrasing so buyers understand the album is for screen captures, not every photo on the device.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Screenshots-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 截屏相簿, 屏幕截图, and 截屏标记 each signal different intent from general 图库 or Recents keywords.

FAQ

Does taking a screenshot auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Screenshots album organization and screen-capture flows control runtime library behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Screenshots, screen capture, screenshot markup, full-page screenshot, 截屏, 截屏相簿, 屏幕截图, and 截屏标记 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement screen capture or markup in code?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. PhotoKit album organization, capture UI, markup editing, and full-page Safari capture engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Recents, Imports, and iCloud Photos pages?

Screenshots listing copy covers Photos → Albums → Screenshots — iOS screen captures, markup, and full-page Safari shots on gallery frames. Recents and Camera Roll are general library surfaces — contrast only. Imports listing copy covers camera and SD card imported media. Places listing copy covers location-based albums. Duplicates listing copy covers duplicate detection and merge. iCloud Photos listing copy covers personal library cloud sync. People & Pets listing copy covers face-grouped albums. Shared Albums listing copy covers collaborative album invitations. Memories listing copy covers For You Memory movies. Featured Photos listing copy covers For You highlight grids. Each surface has a separate guide.

Why do my Screenshots screenshot captions still say Screenshots in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 截屏相簿, 屏幕截图, or 截屏标记 value.

截屏相簿 and 屏幕截图 fit Screenshots album and screen-capture marketing. 最近项目 fits Recents or general library browsing contrast vocabulary — related surfaces but not the primary Screenshots hero unless your English listing centers Recents browsing.
